How to connect Kiwi-Volt

Step 1 — Set up free hosting

Open Cloudflare and create a free account.

In Cloudflare, go to Workers & Pages → Create → Pages → Direct Upload. Upload your Kiwi-Volt website folder and publish it.

Cloudflare will provide a temporary address such as kiwi-volt.pages.dev (the actual address depends on availability).

Step 2 — Connect Crazy Domains

Log in at Crazy Domains.

Select kiwi-volt.co.nz, then open DNS Settings.

Crazy Domains supports adding CNAME records through its DNS management interface.

crazydomains.co.nz+1

Step 3 — Configure the website address

First, add www.kiwi-volt.co.nz under Custom Domains in your Cloudflare Pages project.

Then create or update the following record in Crazy Domains, using the actual Pages hostname assigned to your project.

Setting

CNAME

www

Your assigned *.pages.dev address

If an existing www record conflicts, replace it only after confirming its current purpose. Cloudflare will then verify the domain and provision HTTPS.

For the non-www address, kiwi-volt.co.nz, I recommend configuring a redirect to www.kiwi-volt.co.nz once the main website works.

Important: Do not change your MX, SPF, DKIM or other email records. We want to ensure sales@kiwi-volt.co.nz continues working.

My recommendation: GitHub Pages is a good choice if you want to manage your website files in GitHub and make updates over time. Cloudflare Pages is slightly simpler for uploading a ZIP without using Git.

Important consideration for Kiwi-Volt
